backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the CivWorld backend, defining all data types (UserProfile, Post, Poll, Group, etc.) and including mixins for blob storage and authorization with migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that mirrors all backend data type definitions and provides a run function to handle stable state schema upgrades between canister versions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels, covering actor initialization guards, post/poll/group creation flows, and other backend-frontend integration fixes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key implementation details, serving as a reference for the current state of all frontend components, hooks, and pages.
frontend/ANDROID_BRANDING_ASSETS.md: Documents the source branding assets (app icon, adaptive icon, splash screen) stored in public/assets/generated and explains how they are used to generate Android native resources for the Capacitor build.
frontend/ANDROID_PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md: Step-by-step guide for building a production Android App Bundle (AAB) for Google Play Store submission, covering prerequisites, signing key creation, and build steps.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for the Android project directory, excluding IDE files, build outputs, keystore files, and Capacitor config.
frontend/android/keystore/README.md: Documentation-only readme explaining what an Android keystore is and how to create one using keytool, with a warning not to store actual keystore files in version control.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration for the CivWorld Android app, specifying app ID, web directory, allowed navigation URLs for ICP, and splash screen plugin settings.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the frontend app, mounting the React app at `#root` and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/scripts/android-build.sh: Shell script that automates the CivWorld Android build process by running the web build, syncing with Capacitor, and producing either a debug APK or release AAB.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application file that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes, React Query client, theme provider, and the shared Layout with Header and BottomNav.
Installs a shim that intercepts `window.open` calls for Internet Identity URLs in Capacitor and redirects them to the Capacitor Browser plugin for proper authentication flow.
frontend/src/capacitor/README.md: Documentation listing prerequisites and initial setup steps for building CivWorld as an Android app using Capacitor.
frontend/src/capacitor/runtime.ts: Provides platform detection utilities to determine if the app is running in a Capacitor native environment and identify the current platform (iOS, Android, or web).
frontend/src/capacitor/TROUBLESHOOTING_I: Troubleshooting guide for diagnosing Internet Identity authentication issues in the CivWorld Android Capacitor app.
frontend/src/components/AnalyticsDashboa: React component that displays user analytics including stat cards for posts/likes/polls/followers, trending hashtags, top posts, and top contributors.
frontend/src/components/BadgeDisplay.tsx: React component that renders a row of civic badge icons with tooltips, supporting configurable sizes and a maximum display count with overflow indicator.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with five nav items (Home, Reels, Discuss, Polls, Communities) that highlights the active route.
frontend/src/components/BuildInfoIndicat: Small UI component that displays the current build ID alongside a code icon, intended for developer reference.
frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx: Renders a chat interface between the current user and another user, showing messages fetched via query hooks and a disabled input field with a send button (messaging feature marked as coming soon).
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Implements a nested comment section for posts with support for adding, editing, deleting, liking/unliking, replying to, and reporting comments, using various query hooks and UI components.
frontend/src/components/CreateDiscussion: A modal dialog form for creating a new civic discussion with fields for category, title, context, and region, submitting via the useCreateDiscussion mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupModal: A modal dialog for creating a new group with name, description, and optional cover image upload, handling file-to-blob conversion and submission via the useCreateGroup mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupPageM: A simple selection modal that lets users choose between navigating to the create-group or create-page routes, presenting each option with an icon and description.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupPostM: A modal dialog for creating a post within a specific group, supporting text and image content with upload progress tracking and backend error handling.
frontend/src/components/CreatePollCard.t: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/CreatePostCard.t: A card component for creating posts with optional text, image, or video content, dispatching a custom event on successful post creation.
frontend/src/components/CVTBalanceCard.t: Displays a user's CVT token balance in a styled gradient card with decorative elements and two disabled action buttons for transaction history and CVT transfer.
frontend/src/components/DashboardCards.t: Displays two dashboard summary cards showing the user's Civic Token balance and verification status, with a loading skeleton state.
frontend/src/components/EditConstituency: A modal for updating the user's constituency/location using a hierarchical location selector, converting between display and storage formats before saving.
frontend/src/components/EditPostModal.ts: A modal dialog for editing the text content of an existing post, preserving existing media attachments and showing read-only author and timestamp metadata.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal form for editing the current user's profile fields (name, bio, location) using a hierarchical location selector and saving via mutation.
frontend/src/components/EditProfilePictu: A modal dialog component for uploading, previewing, and removing a user's profile photo, with validation, processing, and upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/GroupsPagesFAB.t: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky app header with logo, App/Wallet view toggle, admin panel link, profile navigation, and Internet Identity login/logout button.
frontend/src/components/HierarchicalLoca: A multi-level location selector (country → state → district → MP/MLA constituency) with searchable dropdowns that load options hierarchically via query hooks.
frontend/src/components/HorizontalNav.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/PartnershipBanne: A simple decorative banner component displaying a 'Partnership Program' heading with a gradient background and sparkle icon.
frontend/src/components/PollCard.tsx: Displays a poll with voting options, shows results with percentages after voting, and handles authenticated vote submission with loading and optimistic states.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Renders a social feed post card with like/unlike, comments toggle, share, edit, delete, and report actions, supporting image and video content.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that collects a new user's name, bio, and location to create their CivWorld profile, blocking dismissal until submission.
A styled promotional banner card that advertises the Communities feature and navigates to '/communities' on button click.
frontend/src/components/QuickPostBar.tsx: A trigger bar and dialog for creating posts with optional image/video attachments, handling upload progress and authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/ReportModal.tsx: A dialog for reporting a post, comment, or profile by selecting a reason and optional description, with success and duplicate-error states.
Displays a horizontally scrollable list of trending hashtags with counts, supporting selection highlighting and navigation to topic pages.
frontend/src/components/VerificationStat: A card component that shows whether a user's account is verified, with distinct styling and a disabled action button for each state.
frontend/src/components/VerifiedBadge.ts: A small icon component that renders a checkmark badge with a tooltip indicating a verified account, supporting three size variants.
frontend/src/components/WalletView.tsx: Displays the user's Civic Token balance, placeholder Send/Receive action buttons, a coming-soon notice, and an empty recent activity section.
frontend/src/context/ViewContext.tsx: Defines a React context for switching between 'app' and 'wallet' views, providing a `ViewProvider` component and a `useView` hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication via `AuthClient`, exposing an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook with login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocationQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching hierarchical location data (countries, states, districts, MP/MLA constituencies, mandals, villages) from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Central collection of React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, posts, comments, groups, analytics, and mutations like creating/liking/reporting content.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Inter/Poppins fonts, configuring Tailwind, and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including brand colors (saffron, deep blue).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrappers around the root `App` component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays reported content (posts, comments, profiles) with actions to delete content or suspend users, accessible only to admins.
frontend/src/pages/CommunitiesPage.tsx: Displays a tabbed page listing all Groups and Pages with card components for each, and a floating create menu for authenticated users to navigate to group/page creation.
frontend/src/pages/CreateGroupPage.tsx: Form page for creating a new group with name, description, and optional cover image upload, using the useCreateGroup mutation and ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePagePage.tsx: Form page for creating a new community page with name, searchable category dropdown, description, privacy toggle, and optional profile image upload via useCreatePage mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePollPage.tsx: Form page for creating a poll with a question, 2–6 dynamic options, and a public/private toggle, submitting via the useCreatePoll mutation.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays a feed of discussion posts fetched via useGetPosts, with a CreatePostCard shown to authenticated users and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/pages/EducationPage.tsx: Static civic education page with tabbed views for learning modules and quizzes, using hardcoded sample data and a detail view for individual modules.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: A placeholder 'Events & Campaigns' page that displays a 'Coming Soon' message with feature previews (event creation, RSVP, location-based discovery, reminders) using card and icon components.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: An explore page with three tabs—Trending (top liked posts), Groups (all groups list), and Analytics—fetching data via query hooks and rendering posts or group cards.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDetailPage.tsx: A detail page for a single group showing its cover image, description, member count, join/leave controls, and a feed of group posts with a create-post modal.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsAndPagesPage.ts: A combined listing page with tabs for Groups and Pages, displaying clickable cards for each and a create button that navigates to the communities route.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: A groups listing page that fetches and displays all groups as clickable cards with cover images, and provides a button to navigate to the group creation route.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The main home feed page that renders promotional banners, a trending section, a constituency shortcut, a quick post bar for authenticated users, and a paginated list of posts.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: A messaging page that lets users enter a Principal ID to start a conversation, then renders a ChatWindow component for the selected user.
frontend/src/pages/MyAreaPage.tsx: A local issues reporting page where authenticated users can submit and view community issues with statuses (new, inReview, resolved) stored in local state.
frontend/src/pages/MyConstituencyPage.ts: Displays the user's location hierarchy (country, state, district, constituency) fetched from their profile, with an option to edit it via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/PageDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single community page fetched by ID, including its name, category, description, privacy status, owner, and creation date.
frontend/src/pages/PagesPage.tsx: Lists all community pages fetched from the backend and provides a button to navigate to the page creation flow.
frontend/src/pages/PollResultsPage.tsx: Displays detailed poll results using mock data, including vote breakdowns by option and region hierarchy, comments, and sharing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/PollsPage.tsx: Displays a list of civic polls fetched via useGetPolls, with loading skeletons, empty state, a create poll button, and a banner linking to detailed poll results.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows the authenticated user's profile (photo, bio, stats) with tabs for their posts and an analytics dashboard, plus modals for editing profile info and picture.
frontend/src/pages/ReelPage.tsx: Placeholder page displaying a 'Reels Coming Soon' message with a Film icon and descriptive text.
frontend/src/pages/SharePage.tsx: Content creation page with a CreatePostCard component and placeholder cards for event creation and video upload, navigating home after a post is created.
frontend/src/pages/TopicPage.tsx: Filters all posts by a hashtag topic from the URL params and renders matching PostCard components with a loading and empty state.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Displays a public user profile by principal ID, showing their posts, follow/unfollow controls, verification status, and a report modal.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPage.tsx: Placeholder page showing a 'Video Feed Coming Soon' message with a Video icon.
frontend/src/pages/VideoReelsPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical scroll reel page using mock video data, supporting like/comment/share interactions with snap scrolling and overlay UI.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Displays the user's wallet page with CVT token balance, verification status, and a CivPoints quick-access card; redirects unauthenticated users to the profile/login page.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPointsPage.tsx: Shows a detailed CivPoints wallet view including current balance, daily/total earned stats, level, and a scrollable point transaction history with labeled action types.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines all shared TypeScript interfaces and enums for the frontend, covering user profiles, wallets, posts, comments, polls, groups, pages, notifications, analytics, local issues, and political discussions.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Provides centralized error handling utilities that parse IC agent and Candid error formats and map them to user-friendly English messages.
frontend/src/utils/buildId.ts: Derives a runtime build identifier by extracting a hash from loaded script URLs, falling back to a timestamp-based ID, to help diagnose stale-client issues after redeploy.
frontend/src/utils/candidOption.ts: Provides helper functions for normalizing and validating MediaContent payloads (text, image, video) before sending them to the backend via Candid optional serialization.
frontend/src/utils/profilePhotoValidatio: Validates profile photo files for type and size constraints, and processes them by center-cropping to a square and compressing to JPEG at 800×800 pixels.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, defining custom colors (using oklch CSS variables), fonts, breakpoints, border radii, shadows, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins with dark mode support.
frontend/WALLET_VISIBILITY_AUDIT.md: Audit checklist documenting that wallet UI (WalletPage, /wallet route, Header and BottomNav entries) was missing and summarizing the resolution steps and build verification utilities added.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 3) for a social platform with posts, polls, groups, and pages features, documenting known issues around broken canister actor bindings and listing existing fix-request features with their requirement IDs.
